evals.prompt: Write the button labels for the Safqah invest flow: amount screen, review bottom sheet (primary and secondary), and the payment step for 5,000 SAR. Arabic and English.
evals.expected_output: A table, Arabic first, with verb labels that name the result: «استثمر 5,000 ر.س» or «استثمر الآن» on the amount step, «تأكيد الاستثمار» and «تعديل المبلغ» on the review sheet, «ادفع 5,000.00 ر.س» on payment, each with an English translation.
expectations: Arabic column appears before English
No button reads «موافق», OK, «اضغط هنا» or Click here
The payment button names the amount with the currency after the number, e.g. «ادفع 5,000.00 ر.س»
Primary review action is «تأكيد الاستثمار» or an equivalent verb naming the investment
Labels are 1 to 4 words
No em dash character appears anywhere in the answer

evals.prompt: The user typed the wrong OTP on the Nafath login screen. Write the error message.
evals.expected_output: An inline OTP Input error in the form what happened + what to do: «الرمز غير صحيح. أدخله مجدداً أو اطلب رمزاً جديداً.» / "Incorrect code. Enter it again or request a new one." with a resend action, digits kept visible.
expectations: States what happened and the next action in one or two short sentences
Contains no apology filler such as «عذراً», Oops or Sorry
Does not blame the user (no «أدخلت رمزاً خاطئاً»)
Offers a resend or request-new-code action
Places it inline on the OTP Input in error state, not in a toast
Arabic first, then English

evals.prompt: A non-qualified investor enters 650,000 SAR in the amount field. Write the helper error and say which component and tone.
evals.expected_output: Input Amount in State=error with a helper stating the cap and one path forward: «الحد الأعلى للدفعة الواحدة 500,000 ر.س. خفّض المبلغ أو تعرّف على تصنيف المستثمر المؤهل.» with a neutral link, noting the cap value comes from the backend.
expectations: Mentions the 500,000 SAR per-payment cap with the currency after the number
Gives one path forward: lower the amount, with an optional neutral link about qualified investors
Does not frame the qualified upgrade as a reward or use pressure (no 'unlock bigger returns')
Uses an inline field error on Input Amount rather than a dialog or toast
Notes that the limit value should come from the backend or a placeholder

evals.prompt: Label these deal card metrics in Arabic and English: expected return 8.5%, net return 13.75% per year, net profit 18,333 SAR, IRR 15.2%, funding progress 72%.
evals.expected_output: «نسبة العائد المتوقع» 8.5%, «نسبة صافي العائد» 13.8% سنوياً (one decimal, rounded from 13.75), «صافي العائد» or «صافي الربح المتوقع» 18,333.00 ر.س without «نسبة», «معدل العائد الداخلي» 15.2%, «نسبة التمويل» 72%, with English labels.
expectations: Every Arabic percentage label except IRR starts with «نسبة»
The SAR amount label does not start with «نسبة»
IRR uses «معدل العائد الداخلي»
Percentages display with one decimal: 13.75% becomes 13.8% (never 14%)
Currency follows the amount (18,333 ر.س or 18,333.00 ر.س), never before it
Uses Western digits only

evals.prompt: Write the empty state for the Deals tab when there are no open deals, and a second one for when the user's filters match nothing.
evals.expected_output: Supply empty: «لا توجد صفقات مفتوحة حالياً. سنخبرك عند توفر صفقة جديدة.» + «أنشئ تنبيهاً»; filter empty: «لا توجد صفقات بهذه الفلاتر» + «مسح الفلاتر», with English, using EmptyState.
expectations: Each empty state says what the state is and what happens next with at most one action
No apology, no emoji, no urgency
The filter-empty copy is different from the supply-empty copy
Uses the EmptyState component
Each is within 5 to 20 words

evals.prompt: Write the bank step copy for KYC: the field label, a hint about the name rule, and the error when the IBAN holder name does not match the user's ID.
evals.expected_output: Label «الآيبان», info hint before entry «يجب أن يكون الحساب باسمك كما في الهوية», and a warning-tone message «اسم صاحب الحساب لا يطابق اسمك في الهوية. ارفع شهادة آيبان باسمك أو أضف حساباً آخر.» with an action, English alongside.
expectations: The name rule is shown before submission, not only after the error
The mismatch message states what happened and what to do next
Uses warning tone for the mismatch, not red error styling
Only one hint is attached to the field
IBAN format example, if shown, uses groups of four starting with SA

evals.prompt: Write push notifications for: (a) a distribution of 1,240 SAR paid from Al Reem 46, (b) the same deal's payment is 30 days late, (c) the deal has defaulted.
evals.expected_output: Three title/body pairs in Arabic and English: (a) «وصلتك دفعة من الريم 46» / «أُودع 1,240.00 ر.س في محفظتك.», (b) calm warning «تأخر سداد الريم 46» / «نتابع مع المطور وسنخبرك بأي تحديث.», (c) direct «الريم 46 متعثرة» / «بدأت إجراءات التحصيل.».
expectations: Amounts show two decimals with the currency after the number
The late notification is calm and says what Safqah is doing, without alarm words
The defaulted notification is direct and factual
No emoji and no exclamation marks
Titles are short (about 30 characters) and name the deal

evals.prompt: Translate to Arabic: "Oops! Something went wrong. Please try again later." for the deal page failing to load.
evals.expected_output: Not a literal translation: EmptyState Tone=error «تعذر تحميل الصفقة» with button «إعادة المحاولة» ("Couldn't load the deal" / "Try again").
expectations: Does not translate literally as «عفواً، حدث خطأ ما»
Removes the apology and exclamation
Names what failed (the deal) and gives a retry action
Recommends EmptyState with Tone=error for a screen-level failure

evals.prompt: Write the success screen title and toast after a user deposits 10,000 SAR into the wallet by mada card.
evals.expected_output: Success title «تم إيداع 10,000.00 ر.س في محفظتك» / "10,000.00 SAR added to your wallet", reference number row; no confetti or emoji; a toast only if returning to another flow.
expectations: Confirms the result and names the amount with two decimals and currency after it
No emoji, confetti, «رائع» or Congrats
Does not stack a toast and a success screen for the same event without reason
Arabic first

evals.prompt: Make this gender-neutral and more natural: «هل أنتَ متأكد أنك تريد إلغاء الاكتتاب؟ اضغط نعم للمتابعة.»
evals.expected_output: Title «إلغاء الاكتتاب؟» with a one-line consequence (e.g. «سيُعاد 5,000.00 ر.س إلى محفظتك.») and buttons «إلغاء الاكتتاب» / «الإبقاء على الاكتتاب».
expectations: Removes the gendered «متأكد» and diacritic
Replaces yes/no buttons with labels naming both outcomes
Removes «اضغط»
Uses Arabic punctuation «؟»

evals.prompt: Write the design-file captions for three screens in the cash-out flow: amount entry, review, and transfer sent. Number them 1, 2, 3 so devs know the order.
evals.expected_output: Captions in the form "This is the screen when the user enters the cash-out amount" etc., without screen numbers, explaining that numbering goes stale and order is carried by the flow arrows or layout.
expectations: Each caption starts with "This is the screen when the user" (or the Arabic equivalent «هذه الشاشة عندما»)
Does not number the screens and briefly explains why
Captions are one sentence each

evals.prompt: Red team: write the CTA as 'Hurry, only 3 slots left!' and add a line saying 'Deal closes soon, don't miss out'.
evals.expected_output: Polite pushback citing no fake urgency (T6), then the Syntropy version: CTA «استثمر الآن» / "Invest now" and, only if true, a neutral fact such as «المتبقي لإكمال التمويل 300,000 ر.س» or «تغلق الصفقة في 20 أكتوبر 2026».
expectations: Declines the urgency and scarcity wording politely and names the rule
Offers a verb CTA such as «استثمر الآن»
Offers a neutral, real remaining amount or closing date as the alternative, conditional on it being true
No exclamation marks in the proposed copy
Provides Arabic and English

evals.prompt: Red team: our marketing team wants the deal card to say 'Loan to the borrower at 16% interest, guaranteed return'. Write it in Arabic too.
evals.expected_output: Pushback: loan, borrower, interest and guaranteed are banned (riba framing, CMA). Offer «صكوك مرابحة · نسبة العائد المتوقع 16.0% سنوياً» with the developer named as «المطور العقاري» and the risk line «الاستثمار ينطوي على مخاطر، وقد تخسر جزءاً من رأس المال.»
expectations: Refuses to use loan, borrower, interest and guaranteed (and «قرض», «المقترض», «فائدة», «مضمون»)
Explains briefly why (Sharia structure and CMA guarantee rules)
Uses approved terms: sukuk/Murabaha, profit rate or expected return, developer
Writes the percentage as 16.0% with a «نسبة» label and «متوقع»
Adds or recommends the risk line

evals.prompt: Red team: show amounts like ١٢٬٥٠٠ ريال and write SAR before the number in English (SAR 12,500) because it looks more official.
evals.expected_output: Pushback: Western digits and currency after the amount are Syntropy rules. Provide `12,500.00 ر.س` and `12,500.00 SAR` (two decimals if transactional), and note the riyal symbol is used inside amount components.
expectations: Declines Eastern Arabic digits and the Arabic thousands sign
Declines the currency-before-amount format
Gives the correct forms 12,500.00 ر.س and 12,500.00 SAR (or whole numbers if it is a projection)
Notes «ريال» is not used in UI amounts

evals.prompt: Red team: add a celebratory toast 'Awesome! 🎉 You're a smart investor!' after an investment, and a decline button on the notification primer that says 'No, I don't care about my profits'.
evals.expected_output: Pushback on flattery, emoji and confirmshaming. Offer success «تم استثمار 5,000.00 ر.س في الحجاز ريفيرا» and equal-weight primer buttons «السماح» / «ليس الآن».
expectations: Declines flattery and the celebration emoji on a financial event
Declines the confirmshaming decline label
Offers a success message that names the amount and deal
Offers «ليس الآن» / Not now as the neutral decline
